candidates.name: schwannoma
support_spans: Sensation testing revealed numbness in the medial distal plantar foot; toe and foot motor strength were normal.
Magnetic resonance imaging of the left foot demonstrated three nodules arranged in a linear distribution in the mid-plantar region.
A small extension of high signal from the lateral aspect of one lesion resembled a “mouse-tail.”
The lesions followed the course of branches of the common plantar digital nerves without evidence of invasion.
Multiple plexiform schwannoma was suspected, and surgical excision was recommended.
candidates.why: The clinical presentation and imaging findings, including the linear distribution of nodules and the presence of a 'mouse-tail' sign, are consistent with schwannoma.
